analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($83.30) vs SMA5/20/50 ($82.74/$82.42/$83.30) - Short-term trend weak, mid-term trend entering neutral zone.
· Below SMA100/200 ($84.18/$85.05) - Mid-to-long-term trend strength maintained.
· 52-week Position (19.3%) - Current price level approaching historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (51.5→53.8) - Exited oversold territory, continuing in neutral zone.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (0.0613→0.2037) - Improvement confirmed, attempting to exit weak convergence zone.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-Band $82.42) - Trading near the mid-band, band width contracting.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($82.77) - Support zone based on SMA20 and Pivot Point (PP).
· Swing Resistance ($84.34) - Resistance zone based on SMA50 and 5-day high.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern - 5-day low ($81.90) > 20-day low ($81.17) suggests potential Higher Low formation, while 5-day high ($83.48) < 20-day high ($83.48) does not confirm a Lower High pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.58) - Recent price action lacks conviction.
· Current Stage Diagnosis - Consolidation within accumulation phase, attempting short-term rebound but entering mid-term resistance zone. Maintain wait-and-see approach, monitoring for SMA50 breakout.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가와 20일 저가 간의 Higher Low 패턴 형성 가능성, 그러나 5일 고가와 20일 고가 간의 명확한 Lower High 패턴은 미확인 상태로 횡보 구간 지속.
